summary: Iteration 10 backend verification COMPLETE. All 18/18 pytest tests pass (100%) against local backend at http://localhost:8001 with LIVE Composio. Verified both bug fixes: BUG A — Instagram post endpoint returns clean HTTP 200 {success:false, platform:'instagram', error:'...'} for unconnected users, with no raw JSON / HTML / stacktrace leakage. _humanize_provider_error mapping still applied for 'Invalid request data' and HTML gateway errors. Regression tests for LinkedIn & Facebook unconnected posts also return clean 200 JSON. BUG B — Unit-tested _linkedin_display_name across all 6 requested cases (flat OpenID name, given+family, legacy localized nested firstName/lastName, nested `data` wrapper, empty dict → None, non-dict → None) and _instagram_display_name_and_id across 4 cases (flat username+id, nested data wrapper, empty → (None,None), non-dict → (None,None)). GET /api/social/all-accounts returns HTTP 200 with correct shape {linkedin:[], facebook_pages:[], instagram:[]} for fresh users. GET /api/social/all-accounts/debug correctly returns 403 for non-admins and 200 for admin-flagged users.

minor.issue: The specific cache-refresh log line 'IG container failed with cache-stale hint; refreshing ig_user_id' was NOT emitted in the seeded stale-cache test — because without a real Composio Instagram connection the container call fails with 'ConnectedAccountNotFound' (returned by Composio before Meta is hit), which is not one of the three cache-stale triggers ('does not exist' / 'missing permissions' / 'object with id'). The user-visible outcome (clean friendly 200 JSON) is verified; the refresh branch itself can only be exercised end-to-end with a real connected IG account whose cached ig_user_id has become stale. Code path was code-reviewed and is correct.

action_items: (Optional) For future E2E coverage of the cache-refresh branch, add an integration test using a monkey-patched _composio_call that simulates Meta's 'Object with ID does not exist' response — that is the only way to trigger the refresh in an isolated env without a real IG Business account.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_post_to_instagram` (lines 1618–1712): cache-stale detection is correct — matches on 'does not exist' / 'missing permissions' / 'object with id' (case-insensitive), invalidates users.<uid>.instagram_user_ids.<cache_key> via $unset, re-discovers, and retries container once. Retry only fires if the fresh id differs from the stale one (good — avoids infinite loop). Final fallback message is user-friendly.

_linkedin_display_name (lines 2076–2120): correctly walks OpenID flat name → given+family → legacy localized firstName/lastName → localizedFirstName/localizedLastName → vanityName → one-level nested wrappers (data/response/profile/user/result). Handles non-dict input.

_instagram_display_name_and_id (lines 2123–2154): tries top-level then nested (data/response/user/account/result), also handles list-of-dicts at wrapper[0]. Strips leading '@' from usernames. Returns (None, None) for empty/non-dict.

list_all_social_accounts (lines 2157–2288): NEW fallback correctly inspects `params`/`metadata`/`data` on the ConnectedAccount object when the discovery API doesn't return a parseable name. Per-platform try/except means one broken auth_config won't fail the whole endpoint.
/social/all-accounts/debug (lines 2291+): admin guard via db.users.find_one → is_admin flag. Non-admin correctly gets 403.
server.py is now 2494 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline. Splitting into modules (routes/social.py, services/composio.py, helpers/social_parsers.py) remains recommended but not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Test module creates two ephemeral users (X-User-Id it10-<uuid> and it10-admin-<uuid>) and one seeded 'test-stale-ig' user with a fake instagram_user_ids._default cache. All seed users are deleted in fixture teardown / try-finally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 backend fixes are fully green. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_10.py covers: 6× LinkedIn extractor unit tests, 4× Instagram extractor unit tests, IG unconnected clean 200, IG stale-cache clean 200 (with seeded user), _humanize_provider_error regressions, LI+FB unconnected regressions, /social/all-accounts shape check, /debug 403 for non-admin, /debug 200 for admin. Any future changes to _post_to_instagram, _linkedin_display_name, or _instagram_display_name_and_id should re-run this file. NOTE: the specific 'cache-stale hint; refreshing ig_user_id' log line is only emitted when Composio returns Meta's exact 'does not exist'/'missing permissions'/'object with id' errors — which cannot be produced without a real connected IG account. In the seed-based test we get 'ConnectedAccountNotFound' instead, which is a different (also correctly-handled) path.
